question: Who among the following was named the goodwill ambassador for Earth Hour India 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P V Sindhu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **P V Sindhu**, a celebrated Indian badminton player, was named the **Goodwill Ambassador for Earth Hour India 2024**.
 
• Earth Hour is a global environmental initiative organized by the **World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF)**. It encourages individuals, communities, and businesses to turn off non-essential electric lights for one hour as a symbol of commitment to the planet.
 
• As the goodwill ambassador, P V Sindhu will raise awareness about the importance of **energy conservation**, combating **climate change**, and adopting sustainable practices.
 
• P V Sindhu's involvement reflects her strong commitment to **environmental conservation** and serves as an inspiration for millions of her fans to participate in this initiative.
 
• The Earth Hour campaign for 2024 aims to focus on **renewable energy** and reducing the carbon footprint, aligning with global efforts to combat climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **P V Sindhu:**

 
 
• P V Sindhu is an **Indian professional badminton player**, born on **5 July 1995** in Hyderabad, India.
 
• She is a recipient of prestigious awards such as the **Padma Bhushan**, **Padma Shri**, and **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• Her landmark achievements include winning a **silver medal** at the **2016 Rio Olympics** and a **bronze medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• She is known for her **dedication**, **discipline**, and the ability to inspire young athletes across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Earth Hour:**
 
 
• Earth Hour was first launched in **2007** by the **WWF** in Sydney, Australia, and has since grown into a global movement.
 
• It is observed annually on the **last Saturday of March**, when participants turn off lights for one hour, from 8:30 PM to 9:30 PM local time.
 
• The movement aims to spread awareness about **environmental challenges** such as **climate change**, **deforestation**, and **energy conservation**.
 
• Earth Hour 2024 will focus on promoting the adoption of **renewable energy** and reducing **greenhouse gas emissions**.
 
 
 
• **World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF):**
 
 
• WWF, founded in **1961**, is one of the world’s leading organizations dedicated to **conserving nature** and reducing the most pressing threats to biodiversity.
 
• The organization operates in over **100 countries** and has over **5 million supporters** worldwide.
 
• Key WWF initiatives include protecting endangered species, conserving forests, reducing plastic pollution, and addressing climate change.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Goodwill Ambassadors:**
 
 
• In past years, several influential personalities such as **actors, athletes, and environmentalists** have served as Earth Hour ambassadors.
 
• These ambassadors play a crucial role in engaging the public and spreading the message of sustainability and conservation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India and Earth Hour:**

 
 
• India has been a strong participant in the Earth Hour movement, with several landmarks such as the **India Gate** and **Gateway of India** going dark to support the cause.
 
• Various schools, colleges, and organizations actively participate to raise awareness about **energy conservation**.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change and Energy Conservation:**
 
 
• Climate change is one of the most significant challenges of the 21st century, with rising global temperatures and extreme weather events posing threats to ecosystems and communities.
 
• Energy conservation and the adoption of renewable energy sources are critical steps to **mitigate climate change**.
